questions.stem: 50-year-old Kim was having coffee in a cafe. After his coffee, he was feeling severe pain in his right leg. His vitals were checked and the blood pressure was 145/91mmHg, saturation was 95% and PR 87bpm. He has a history of smoking one packet daily for the last 30 years. No known previous history of hospitalization and diseases. Physical examination reveals that he got a pitting edema on his right leg extending upto the knee. His peripheral pulses all were symmetrical and full. He was admitted in the hospital and he was started with medications for prolonging activated partial thromboplastin time and prothrombin time in a dose dependent manner. But this caused no any effect in thrombin time. Which of the following agent would have been given to the patient for relief?
